analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misordered the sequence of visited shapes, placing the white square — which was never visited by the arrow — as the 4th shape. This error cascades into incorrect attribute assignment (color = white) and grounding (referencing a non-existent visited object). The ground truth explicitly lists the trajectory as green → purple → red → orange, making the 4th shape unambiguously orange. The model’s reasoning appears to conflate the initial color legend display with the actual traversal path, leading to a complete breakdown in temporal sequencing and object reference.
